body = {
    "title": f"[{alert['source_tool']}] {alert['title']}",
    "priority": severity_to_priority.get(alert["severity"], "P4"),
    "external_ref": alert["event_id"],
}
resp = requests.post(TICKETS_URL, json=body, headers=AUTH, timeout=10)
resp.raise_for_status()
caption: external_ref ties the new ticket back to the originating alert so it can be found again later.
Search by external_ref first — a recurring or retried alert should update a case, not duplicate it.
